rationale:
bugs_open/337, RE-SCOPED TWICE AND I AM SUBMITTING THE SECOND RE-SCOPE, NOT THE BUG'S ORIGINAL CLAIM. Filed as a token-cap bug; that diagnosis was refuted on 2026-08-22 by this lane (73 of 82 generations SUCCEEDED under the old 16,000 cap). The cap work (migration 549 / MDL-042) shipped on independent evidence and MUST NOT be credited with healing any page. The re-scope then blamed bugs_open/309's unresolvable-source class; I measured that too and it is also wrong as stated: of 101 component_validation_rejected rows (2026-08-15..08-22, 4 sites) 97 are the FIELD-CONTRACT rule and 3 are the source-vocabulary rule.

THE DEFECT, ONE SENTENCE: the birth gate enforces two contracts the writer is never shown, from sources the writer never sees, so compliance is left to chance, the gate refuses, the item re-dispatches unchanged and the page parks. 11 needs_new_component items sit parked failed at attempt 3 across 4 sites; loanzy.uk/tool-credit-health-check still serves 3 sections and no tool.

ARM A (field names). load_existing_component_action.go keys the advisory on section_type AND filters is_active=true AND component_level='section'; the gate resolves the row it will overwrite via resolveStorageIdentity->lookupBaseComponent, which keys on FUNCTION and deliberately has NEITHER filter (the is_active filter was dropped 2026-05-06 precisely because the paradigm regeneration target is a DEACTIVATED broken row). A miss leaves the prompt's whole preservation block dormant behind {{if .existing_component.field_names}}, taking the function pin with it. Proven end to end: orchestration 4f321f85 (08-22 12:18Z) had field_names='' and was refused for stranding 4 fields, then SUCCEEDED at 12:53Z when the blind writer reproduced those 4 generic names BY CHANCE; a sibling with 18 obscure names (button_1..button_18) never once succeeded in 70 attempts. So the failure probability scales with the number and obscurity of the fields.

ARM B (source vocabulary). TIER D enumerates query names exactly ('use these EXACTLY - do not invent new ones'). TIER C says only source: site_specs.{path} with three prose examples and NO aspect list, and the live prompt_template never renders {{.site_specs}} anywhere despite site_specs being in input_fields - so the writer has never seen a single aspect name and is guessing every time. The live blocker is a ONE-CHARACTER miss: it declared site_specs.ctas.primary_url/secondary_url when the aspect is 'cta', which carries EXACTLY primary_url and secondary_url. Both arms reuse the GATE'S OWN functions (LoadKnownSpecAspects, KnownAspectsSorted, resolveStorageIdentity) rather than re-querying, so offer and enforcement are one computation - bugs_open/282's remedy, and the shape 016b §9/092 already shipped, council-APPROVED and induced ('the writer's allow-list and the gate's accept-set cannot diverge').

ARM C, AND I AM LEADING WITH THE RISK RATHER THAN BURYING IT. store_generated_component_action.go:552 heals a NULL section_type on a SUCCESSFUL store, so the repair is gated behind the success its own absence prevents. I add the same COALESCE on the REJECTION path. section_type is what the SELECTOR keys on, so healing makes a component visible to page planning - and migration 036 deactivates broken components precisely so pages stop choosing them. Healing an inactive row would therefore offer a component that JUST FAILED THE GATE to page planning, strictly worse than the invisibility being repaired. So the write is gated on is_active=true: it fills a metadata gap on rows the estate already treats as live and NEVER revives one. It writes one NULL column, never the template, never is_active, and is a no-op via 'AND section_type IS NULL'. Mutation-proven: removing the is_active condition fails the dedicated test.

PROPORTION, STATED HONESTLY - PLEASE REJECT ANY READING THAT THIS IS HIGH-FREQUENCY. Arm B's class is RARE: 72 section components created since 2026-05-07 and NONE carries a phantom aspect at rest; only 3 rejections in 4 days. What changed is the CONSEQUENCE, not the rate: the birth gate went live 2026-08-18 and the first phantom-aspect rejection is 2026-08-21 - before the gate this output was STORED and rendered silently blank (309's damage), since the gate it PARKS THE PAGE (337's damage). The gate closed the silent door and opened a page-parking one; nobody gave the writer the information to walk through neither. Arm A likewise has ZERO demand impact today (0 of 14 requested section types are blind) because bugs_open/311's diversion closed it as a SIDE EFFECT on 08-19 - 97 of the 98 field-contract rejections predate it. I am shipping Arm A as prevention plus the is_active hole 311 never touched, and claiming no repair from it.

INTERACTION WITH bugs_open/345, WHICH LANDED WHILE I WAS BUILDING THIS. Migration 555 was applied 2026-08-22 11:08:01Z and last_error is demand-proven (5 orchestrations carry it, all since 11:08Z, against 0 all-history; their item ceea0c07 was refused 12:18:43Z and completed at attempt 1 at 12:53:07Z). So the refusal text NOW reaches the next generation, and that message already enumerates every aspect NAME. Arm B's remaining unique contribution is therefore narrower than it would have been yesterday and I am not overstating it: (1) LEAF PATHS and SITE COVERAGE, which no refusal message carries and which is the only thing letting a writer tell 'aspect cta exists' (passes the gate) from 'cta.primary_url exists on 4 of 26 sites, so mark it optional'; (2) the FIRST generation, saved rather than paid and then corrected; (3) items that have already spent their attempts, like the 11 parked ones, for which no retry remains. Arms A and C are unaffected by 555.

AN AVENUE I TESTED AND CLOSED, so the council does not propose it: replacing the field-contract proxy with the exact contract (dependents' real content_data keys), which the guard's own comment at :448-450 pre-authorises, on the theory that many refusals guarded nothing. MEASURED AND REFUTED: all 10 refused components have 1-2 live page dependents, and loans-credit-health-check's dependent stores 19 keys of which 12 are button_*. R1 was protecting real stored content. Also OUT OF SCOPE deliberately: deep-path source validation. The gate checks only the first segment, so a listed aspect with an invented key still passes and renders blank; closing that must replicate navigateMap plus the resolveSpecAlias chains or over-refuse, its truth is per-site while components are fleet-shared, and it would add a fourth class to a vocabulary config-key-audit --component-source-vocabulary baselines by exact class tuple. That is guarantee-altering on a shared mechanism -> RFC track, and the 309/362 lane's call. The prompt block says so to the writer in terms ('if the value you need is not listed, do NOT invent a path - use static with a fallback, or llm'), which is load-bearing: the sibling remortgagecalculator failure wanted currency_symbol, which NO site carries in any resolvable form, so a vocabulary list alone would not have saved it.

CONSUMERS TOLD, NOT MERELY MEASURED (owner ruling 2026-07-29 §3): the 345/311 lane (told directly this session - they did not know 555 had gone live, and I warned them my attempt-0 change moves the baseline their retry-feedback measurement is pinned against; we agreed sequencing and migration numbers) and the 309/362 lane (Arm B stops new entries to the 69-row population they are burning down; I touch neither the gate nor its deep-path hole). Additive and inert: the Go half writes prompt keys nothing references until migration 562 lands, and that block is {{if}}-guarded so it is dormant until the Go half rolls. No ordering constraint either direction, and I am not claiming one.

plan.summary: The component writer is never shown either contract the birth gate enforces, so it complies by chance, is refused, and regenerates unchanged - 101 rejections in 8 days, 11 items parked at attempt 3, pages shipped without their tool. Make the pre-generation advisory call the GATE'S OWN code for both: resolveStorageIdentity for the field contract (so a NULL-section_type or deactivated row is no longer invisible), and LoadKnownSpecAspects/KnownAspectsSorted plus leaf-path coverage for the source vocabulary. Plus: heal a NULL section_type on the REJECTION path (is_active-gated), so the repair stops being locked behind the success it enables. Advisory throughout - every failure path degrades to today's blind generation and the gate remains the backstop.

edits.rationale: THE RISKIEST EDIT, NAMED FIRST. The regeneration UPDATE already carries this COALESCE but only runs on a SUCCESSFUL store, so a NULL section_type - which hides the row from the selector AND from the writer's advisory - can only be repaired by the success its own absence prevents. GATED ON is_active BECAUSE HEALING MAKES A COMPONENT SELECTABLE: migration 036 deactivates broken components so pages stop choosing them, and healing an inactive row here would offer a just-refused component to page planning. So it fills a metadata gap on rows already treated as live and never revives one. One column, COALESCE so an existing value is never overwritten, 'AND section_type IS NULL' so it is a no-op otherwise, best-effort so a failure cannot turn a rejection into a different error.

Arm A. Today's section_type lookup stays PRIMARY and byte-identical - it is the selector's own query (component_selector.go:183-187) and decoupling them would be a regression - and this fires ONLY on a miss, so it cannot regress a case that works today. It calls the STORE'S resolver, not a bare lookupBaseComponent, and that distinction is load-bearing: a bare by-function lookup would MANUFACTURE refusals in two live cases. On a divert-to-create there is no contract, and naming the incumbent's fields imposes a phantom one AND steers the writer to reproduce a legacy numbered-flat schema TIER D's own text calls 'the wrong shape'; on a divert-to-existing-scoped-row the real contract is the SCOPED row's schema, so naming the base row's makes the writer preserve the wrong set. Reports only when ident.IsRegeneration. Function name derived with NormaliseToKebab and requester read from the same two collected_data paths the store reads (store_generated_component_action.go:113-114), so prediction and enforcement agree by construction. Any error -> advise nothing.
edits.sketch:
functionName := datahelpers.NormaliseToKebab(sectionType)
requesterSiteID := datahelpers.ExtractNestedFieldString(params.CollectedData, "input_data.site_id")
requesterDomain := datahelpers.ExtractNestedFieldString(params.CollectedData, "input_data.domain")
ident, err := resolveStorageIdentity(ctx, params.DB, functionName, requesterSiteID, requesterDomain, logger)
if err != nil { return nil, false }        // advisory: degrade to blind, never block
if !ident.IsRegeneration { return nil, false } // a create has no field contract
names := schemaFieldNamesSorted([]byte(ident.ExistingSchema))
return map[string]interface{}{"field_names": strings.Join(names, ", "), "function": ident.FunctionName, "field_count": len(names)}, true

edits.rationale: Arm B. Calls the guard's OWN LoadKnownSpecAspects and KnownAspectsSorted plus queryresolve.KnownQueryBases, so the list the refusal prints and the list the writer sees cannot drift. Rides EVERY return path including the no-component-found one, because a first-time creation invents an unresolvable source as readily as a regeneration does - the live failure WAS a diverted create; nesting it inside the found-a-row branch is the mutation the test catches. Leaf aspect.key paths carry SITE COVERAGE because the gate validates only the first segment, so bare aspect names would trade a loud refusal for a silent blank (309's damage) - the coverage number is what lets the writer decide whether a field may be required at all (cta is on 4 of 26 sites). FAILS OPEN, and independently of the field lookup: an unreadable aspect set omits the key so the prompt block stays dormant, and must NOT blank the field contract. Rejected alternative: a pure-config query_database step would be a second implementation of the gate's vocabulary in another substrate (the literal 282 anti-pattern), and the query-name half cannot be config at all since queryresolve's map is Go.

Extracts the sort+render the phantom-aspect refusal message inlined at :188-193 into one exported function, and calls it from that message. There are now TWO consumers of one vocabulary rendering and a writer shown one list while judged against another IS the defect - so this makes 'the list the refusal prints' and 'the list the writer sees' the same string by construction rather than by inspection. Message-identical by test: re-inlining a separate sort or separator in either place fails TestKnownAspectsSorted, which asserts the refusal contains 'aspects that exist: ' + the advisory's own rendering. No behaviour change to the guard.

The file had NO tests at all, which is part of how the advisory went three predicates out of step with the guard unnoticed. Eight properties, sqlmock-strict so an unexpected statement fails: section_type hit does NOT consult the resolver (reordering fails it); the blind case recovers the contract and pins the resolved function, with a mixed-case spaced input proving NormaliseToKebab; divert-to-create advises NOTHING; divert-to-scoped-row advises the SCOPED row's fields and explicitly asserts the base row's field name is absent; a resolver error never returns an error and keeps the map well-formed; the vocabulary rides even when both lookups miss; a vocabulary outage does NOT cost the field contract (the two fail-opens are independent); and the guard's message equals the advisory's rendering.

The safety property for Arm C, asserted where a caller cannot forge it: the statement must be SENT carrying 'AND is_active = true' and 'AND section_type IS NULL'. MUTATION-PROVEN, both directions, and the two tests are each other's controls: deleting the is_active condition fails both heal tests (verified by running that mutation), and deleting the whole call fails both on an unmet expectation (also verified). A third test pins that a refused CREATION sends no heal statement at all - firing one would mean writing to a component the store never identified. All three assert the refusal still happens: the heal must never rescue a write the gate refused.
edits.sketch:
mock.ExpectExec(`UPDATE content_components[\s\S]*WHERE id = \$2::uuid[\s\S]*AND is_active = true[\s\S]*AND section_type IS NULL`).
	WithArgs("test-widget", healIncumbentID).WillReturnResult(sqlmock.NewResult(0, 0))
_, err = StoreGeneratedComponentAction(context.Background(), strandingParams(db))
if err == nil { t.Fatal("a stranding regeneration must still be refused - the heal must not rescue the write") }

edits.rationale: The prompt half - the only config change, and dormant until the Go half rolls. snapshot_agent first; DO/RAISE guards on both sides (a verify block of plain SELECTs cannot stop a COMMIT); anchor asserted present EXACTLY ONCE and the new block asserted absent, so a double-apply refuses. Anchor read from the LIVE prompt_template, not from the 093 on-disk snapshot, because the function-pin block proves this prompt has been edited outside the migration trail. Guarded on the RICHEST key (aspect_paths) so the block cannot half-render. The 'if it is not listed, do NOT invent a path - use static with a fallback, or llm' sentence is load-bearing, not decoration: the sibling remortgagecalculator failure wanted currency_symbol, which no site carries in any resolvable form, so a list alone would not have saved it. Migration 561 is taken by the 345 lane - agreed with them directly. Rollback sidecar does an exact-replace removal.

Refuting my own strongest alternative [MEASURED 2026-08-22]: all 10 components carrying a field-contract refusal have 1-2 live page_components dependents, and loans-credit-health-check's dependent stores 19 content_data keys of which 12 are button_* — so the field-contract rule was protecting real stored content and the 'exact contract' rewrite would not have admitted those writes.

Rate control against overstating Arm B [MEASURED 2026-08-22]: 72 section-level components created since 2026-05-07 and NONE carries a phantom aspect at rest; the first phantom-aspect REJECTION is 2026-08-21, three days after the birth gate went live 2026-08-18. The class is rare; what changed is the consequence (silently blank -> parked page).
